items.title: Oli wants some chief ministers to go. Provincial partner against removal ‘so close to elections’
items.summary: Disputes within the UML have put the chief ministers of Koshi and Lumbini under pressure to quit as heat grows against the chief minister in Sudurpaschim over budget.

items.title: Inam Sapkota now says police dictated his statement
items.summary: In an application to the National Human Rights Commission, he alleges police threatened and pressured him to implicate senior political and judicial figures.

items.title: Nepal yet to decide on one-year extension of MCC projects
items.summary: Without more time, projects cannot be completed by the August 2028 deadline, says an MCA-Nepal official.

items.title: Two killed, five seriously injured in tractor accident in Bajura
items.summary: The tractor overturned at Manikanda in Jagannath Rural Municipality while travelling from Piluchaur on Friday evening.

items.title: Explainer: What is Modi’s automated takedown law, which has embroiled Meta in a political storm?
items.summary: The digital rights group Internet Freedom Foundation has criticised the new system, saying that “censorship by automation is still censorship”.

items.title: Minister shares his resolve to improve the state of Nepali sports
items.summary: Amid sharp criticism over the 10th National Games, Sasmit Pokharel spells out strict reforms, regular Games and accountability for sports associations.

items.title: Inam Sapkota seeks protection from human rights commission, alleges coercion and torture
items.summary: In a complaint filed through his wife, Sapkota claims he was blindfolded after being detained at the airport, held at an undisclosed location, forced to give statements against prominent figures and subjected to mental torture.

items.title: Balendra Shah’s India trip: From nationalist posturing to realpolitik
items.summary: Delhi’s warm welcome and a slew of agreements signal an important opening in ties. But translating diplomatic goodwill into tangible outcomes will take more than one visit.

items.title: Home Minister Sudan Gurung to hold traditional wedding in Gorkha
items.summary: Prime Minister Balendra Shah and Rastriya Swatantra Party chairman Rabi Lamichhane are expected to attend the ceremony on December 3, which is also intended to promote the village as a wedding destination.

items.title: Embassy’s refusal stalls Supreme Court ruling on video testimony from abroad
items.summary: A landmark ruling allowing accused persons overseas to testify remotely remains unimplemented after Nepali embassy in Australia says it has neither authority nor the facilities to enforce the court order.

items.title: Court remands former chief secretary Aryal for four days
items.summary: Ek Narayan Aryal is being investigated over alleged fraud and organised crime linked to extra biomedical fees charged to Nepali workers seeking jobs in Malaysia.

items.title: Trump says he asked Putin to ‘pull back’ military aggression throughout Europe
items.summary: Trump did not ​elaborate on what conduct he was asking Putin to halt. Since the Russian invasion of Ukraine started in 2022, other countries have occasionally accused Russia of provocative behaviour.

items.title: Bhotekoshi flood victims may get up to Rs800,000 for new homes
items.summary: The government plans to provide one-time housing grants based on geographical regions, while families who lost their land will be included in an integrated housing programme.

items.title: Mahakali bridge opens, ending years of risky river crossings
items.summary: Jointly inaugurated by Prime Ministers Balendra Shah and Narendra Modi, the bridge replaces risky cable and inner-tube crossings between Nepal and India.

items.title: Displaced families protest as Bode holding centre faces eviction deadline
items.summary: Residents banged plates after receiving no food by noon, hours before the government’s 2pm deadline to vacate the centre.

items.title: Rabi Lamichhane meets President Paudel
items.summary: Talks at Sheetal Niwas covered the government, parliament, ordinances and current political developments, according to Lamichhane’s secretariat.

items.title: Army storm into women’s cricket semifinals with 97-run win over Karnali
items.summary: Karnali crash out of the 10th National Games after suffering their second consecutive defeat. Samjhana Khadka stars with a halfcentury.
